highlights.title: A promise before this life
passages: Irmão Gonçalves told us an amazing story. He had an investigator he taught and he was blessed with an insight that he knew her in the PreMortal life and had promised her he would learn english and bring her the truth. There are friends here in São Paulo that I have promised to bring the truth, may God let me find them.

highlights.title: A glimpse of God’s children
passages: I had a small glimpse inside the eyes of the Elders in my district today. Just for a second I could see the spirit bodies of God’s children. It was an interesting moment. Perhaps spiritual gifts can come by expanding our mind and hearts; perhaps intelligence is truly the key...

highlights.title: A witness of God’s timing
passages: I find it amazing how the Lord can work good, even through all of our mortal weaknesses, pride, and mistakes. Like how it took me 2 years longer than it should have to get here on my mission, but the spirit bears witness that it is God’s plan that I’m here with all my brothers here with me.

highlights.title: Learning to listen while giving a blessing
passages: Had my first opportunity to give a blessing today. Sister Hulse has been sick with a bad cough and asked for a blessing. It was cool, and I was nervous. I blessed her to be healed and have the ability to focus in her studies. I just blessed as it came to my mind – perhaps a good lesson for me on listening to the spirit. I thank God for this opportunity.

highlights.title: Following a prompting to express gratitude
passages: After Irmão Gonçalves’ class I felt like I should tell him how he inspires me; But he had already walked down the hall, so Elder McKee and I headed to the room. But something compelled me to turn and tell him, so I did. I’m not sure why I felt I should, but I think it was an inspired thought. God has answered my prayer and is helping me learn to receive revelation.

highlights.title: An answer through the gift of tongues
passages: We sat by some brasileiros at lunch and I was able to have somewhat of a normal conversation with them. It was exciting. I was even able to understand them easier than usual. Truly the gift of tongues, and the interpretation, that I’ve been praying for being given to me. I’m so thankful that God has blessed me with the opportunity to serve here in Brazil and that he is providing me the tools and abilities to be successful.

highlights.title: A small lesson in reverence
passages: During the devotional I was writing a quote down and the closing prayer was announced, but I decided to keep writing through the prayer... then my pen stopped working. I recognized my error, repented, and after the pray the pen worked again. pretty funny, but no doubt a sign!

highlights.title: Led by the Spirit while testifying
passages: I really felt like we were led by the Spirit and found people who will read it.

The best contact though was a muslim. He didn’t accept the BoM at first so we asked him why and he explained how nobody knows which church is true. Then I taught Him about the Apostasy and the First Vision, had him read Moroni’s promise and testified. He was touched and promised us that he would read it. It was amazing! Never thought I’d give a BoM to a Muslim. He seemed really interested after we taught him.

highlights.title: A message that God is grateful
passages: God is Thankful that I am serving a mission. Irmão Gonçalves felt that he should tell us that while he was at Sacrament. God truly is thankful and grateful that I am here. It is a good feeling knowing this. I am truly thankful to be here as well.

highlights.title: A blessing while sick
passages: I felt really sick today. I had Elders McKee, Gardner and Johnson give me a blessing. By the end of the day I am feeling better.

highlights.title: A confirmation of Christ’s ministry
passages: I got to see The Testaments film, it was really good. I really felt the Spirit of the truthfulness of the Gospel being in the Americas.

highlights.title: A witness grounded in the Book of Mormon
passages: My faith and testimony ride on the Book of Mormon, it truly is the Keystone. The spirit was so real when I sought the confirmation. I’m glad I have hearkened to the Spirit, and I hope that all my weaknesses of faith may be strengthened while I’m on my Mission.

highlights.title: Recognizing the Spirit together
passages: Then we talked with Bel and Nubia and I shared my testimony about the Book of Mormon and feeling the Spirit – It was awesome and I felt the Spirit alot, and told them they were feeling it too. Way cool.

highlights.title: Led to a prepared family
passages: Two days ago we contacted a boy named Jonathan. Today we taught his family. They accepted baptism without hesitation. It was amazing. They were prepared by the Lord.
It’s amazing to see how God leads us to the elect.

highlights.title: The Spirit in a lesson on faith and the Atonement
passages: Had a good lesson today with Bel and Nubia. We felt some progression. We are working to resolve their concerns and have them commit to be baptized. It was good, the Spirit was strong, E Phillips taught about the atonement and I taught about faith.

highlights.title: The Spirit speaking through a missionary
passages: Had a good experience today with the family of Ezequiel. I shared a message with them about Mosiah 3:19, about how we need to develop Christ-like attributes to apply the Atonement in our lives. His wife told me she saw the mantle come over me and felt the Spirit talking through me. Way cool. These experiences are the ones that I want to have on my mission – knowing that the Spirit is working through me; knowing that I am bringing souls to Christ.

highlights.title: A growing witness while teaching
passages: Today I felt the Spirit a lot. With Lorival and Elysangela we watched the end of The Testaments, the Spirit was very strong. And with Cristina and Duda, I bore my testimony about my conversion and we watched a small clip about Thomas S. Monson and the Spirit was there too. I’m very happy that I got to feel the Spirit so strong today. I love to feel my testimony grow.

highlights.title: A first baptism
passages: Today was Christhian’s baptism. It was a good experience. My first baptism ever. I hope he felt the power of the atonement today. I hope I was a good priesthood holder today and helped him feel the Spirit of this ordinance. I pray he stays strong and serves a mission. I’m very thankful for this opportunity and for the opportunity to serve. Christhian will be a good example to his family... they will follow him. This work is powerful, this work is true, Christ lives.

highlights.title: The gift of tongues while bearing testimony
passages: In Gospel Principles class I bore my testimony today on the Gift of Tongues and I felt the Gift of Tongues working in me while I spoke. It was easy and clear. The Spirit was there. It was cool. Then afterwards I felt it lift from me. It’s cool to see how it comes to help the work have power to the convincing of the hearts of the children of God.

highlights.title: A witness of the Restoration
passages: We had a really good restoration lesson today. It was with an older couple, João e Luzia. They are really open to the message and believed it; I’m excited about them. I taught the message about the first vision for the first time with them. I felt the Spirit a lot. During this lesson my testimony of Joseph Smith grew. I caught a glimpse of him and all the work that he did. I realized that Jesus did everything he did knowing that Joseph Smith would restore the truth. I’m very thankful for this testimony God has given me.

highlights.title: A lesson that moved Paloma to tears
passages: Today we had a good lesson with Paloma to help take away her concerns. It was really good. I felt the gift of tongues come upon me and I preached with the Spirit. The Spirit was so strong it brought her to tears.
I felt strongly that the church needs her for some reason. She can recognize the Spirit really easily... this will be a benefit to her as she gains a strong testimony.

highlights.title: A witness while reading the Book of Mormon
passages: We also met with Pedro and read the Book of Mormon with him. While we were reading I gained a better testimony of it. Somehow I just had such a feeling of its truthfulness – that the people really existed and that Christ really appeared to them.

highlights.title: Paloma’s answer to prayer
passages: Paloma told us today she wants to be baptized. She really has a testimony, it’s awesome to see. She said she gained this confirmation after our lesson with her on the 23rd. After that lesson she prayed and gained the confirmation she needed to know the church is true. It’s cool to see that the Lord sent me here to help her.
The lesson with her today was a really spiritual lesson also. She bore her testimony and it moved her and her friend Diana to tears. The spirit in Irmã Fatima’s house was really strong, I loved it.

highlights.title: Revelation about building companionship unity
passages: I received a revelation today about how to make this area good for both of us. I feel if I focus on the language always it will help us have unity and focus, and of course, help me learn the language fast.

highlights.title: Understanding the infinite Atonement
passages: I had a bit of a revelation about how the Atonement is infinite; because it’s happening now. All points of time passed before Christ in that moment, so as we live and use our agency, we literally are deciding what sins he will pay for. So, when he says if you love me, keep my commands, he’s saying if you love me don’t commit the sin that will cause me to suffer – because the atonement is still happening now – even though the physical suffering occured in a single moment. It’s eternal because it’s not bound by time, is happening, was happening, yet all passed before Him in an instant. It’s hard to explain in writing but it’s cool to understand better. The best way I can think to say it simply is that “It’s still happening then.” That’s how it’s eternal. I’m grateful to be receiving more light and truth as I grow.

highlights.title: A taste of the pure love of Christ
passages: Had a good lesson today with a girl named Stefani. She is in a part member family. We watched the Testaments and afterwards I testified about the restoration and invited her to be baptized – she accepted. Afterwards I felt a really good Spirit that the Lord was truly rejoicing for her decision to be baptized. It was a taste of the pure love of Christ, that I could rejoice for someone I barely know. It was a really good experience.

highlights.title: A testimony that invited the Spirit
passages: First, I did a division with Elder Nunes, we did a tour of the Temple for a pesquisador of his. I felt the Spirit really strong, in the form of Tranquility. After the lesson, Elder Nunes said that the Testimony I shared was important, that he felt the Spirit really strong. That was a blessing to hear that from him. I needed the reassurance that God is working thru me. Sometimes it’s easy to miss the miracles God is having you do because of doubt, and this was an experience that strengthened my faith.

today at lunch we had a spiritual experience. We showed the DVD about President Monson to Irmão Jurandir – the part about Crystal and his testimony at the end. And afterwards Elder Pacheco bore his testimony and then I bore mine. I shared with them how I asked God if the Book of Mormon was true, if Joseph Smith was a prophet, and if Thomas S Monson was the Prophet today – and that I received a powerful answer. As I spoke, I watched the Spirit touch Irmão Jurandir’s heart and tears filled his eyes. He was inspired to leave a reference with us that I think will be good. I am so thankful God gave me a miracle to use on the mission – a testimony that truly invites the Spirit.

highlights.title: An unexpected path to a family
passages: We had a good spiritual experience yesterday. Elder Pacheco and I went to Sousas super excited to teach 2 families – but neither were home. But we found an Irmã on the street who gave us a phone number of a family that’s less active that moved here recently. We went and visited them and it was really good. They will start going to church. They have a love for the church and for the Elders. They also passed a lead for a job for Silvia, which a great blessing.

highlights.title: A confirmation about the other side of the veil
passages: Then when we arrived I felt the Spirit guide the lesson. At the start, I just wanted to invite everyone to go to church. But then Consuelo started talking about since the baptism she has had a peace in her life, so I shared João 14:26 and testified about the Gift of the Holy Ghost. Then she shared that at her baptism her mom came to her mind, which was weird because her mom passed away 22 years ago and it’s been a while since she thought about her mom. Then I testified that it was a vision from God. That her mom had been waiting for this moment and is rejoicing on the other side of the veil. As I said this I felt a strong confirmation that it was, indeed, true. It’s amazing to have such an experience with the Holy Ghost. The Spirit World exists and their work needs to be done; they’re waiting. I know this now.

highlights.title: Nildo’s dreams and conversion
passages: We had a really good lesson with Nildo yesterday, he explained his conversion to us. He was attending the Igreja Universal, his Mom is a member but he never listened to the missionaries. Then one day he was watching TV and had a revelation that he needed to be baptized. So, he prayed about it. That night he had a dream that God would send 2 angels to him. The next week Elder Pacheco and Elder Hahne were inspired to visit him. He said Elder Hahne taught about all the things that had been on his mind – he was blown away, especially because it was his first time to accept the missionaries. Elder Pacheco left the invitation to read & pray about the Book of Mormon; he did. That night he had a dream and he saw a Book of Mormon glowing w/ a celestial light, so he knows it’s true. He also said that during our visit he could see light shining from us. Wow. It was a really interesting experience, truly sacred things for his life, I’m glad he shared them with us. He said his goal now is to go to church and be baptized. What a miracle.

highlights.title: A sacred blessing for a premature baby
passages: Elder Pacheco and I had the opportunity to go to the hospital today to give blessings.

we blessed her baby, which is in intensive care because it was born premature. I felt the Spirit really strong and sweet during the blessing – the baby will survive and be an advocate of Christ, this I know. I’m thankful God is giving us these sacred experiences.

highlights.title: Joy at Stefani’s baptism
passages: Yesterday was the baptism of Stefani. It was a really good baptism, I felt the Spirit really strong. An interesting thing happens to me at baptisms, I can’t seem to stop smiling. I receive a complete joy. It is such a feeling of peace and happiness – I think it’s a glimpse of the Celestial Kingdom. Beatrice bore her testimony for Stefani after the ordinance. It was powerful and emotional. She spoke about how happy she was to have one more person in her family join the Church. She started to cry and expressed her desire that Carlos, her dad, join the church too. It’s amazing that a nine year old can have such a solid testimony and invite the Spirit with such purity. Truly the Gift of the Holy Ghost. It’s an amazing work to help people obtain this Gift.

highlights.title: Led by the Lord while teaching
passages: The Lord was with me and led me how to teach. In hindsight, it’s humbling.
It’s amazing to see how the Lord is blessing me with this language. The Gifts of the Spirit are true. I’m gaining a strong testimony of how we can do ALL things with the aid of the Lord.

highlights.title: Tears of joy at three baptisms
passages: Sunday we had the baptisms of Mariana, Alessandra, Geovanna; the daughters of Silvia. I went there Saturday with Elder Greener and invited them to be baptized. It felt really good. Mariana had doubts but we helped her understand that baptism is accepting Christ and showing her love for Him. Their baptism was really spiritual. It brought tears to my eyes. It’s amazing to be doing the work of the Lord.

highlights.title: United faith in a priesthood blessing
passages: we gave him a blessing. Elder Pacheco anointed and I sealed it. I felt the Spirit really strong. Elder Greener helped too. It’s always good to have the faith of priesthood holders united in the work of Christ.

highlights.title: Recognizing the Atonement’s power to change
passages: I felt today the growth I have received from the Lord over the past year and a half. It’s becoming really easy to feel when the Spirit comes and goes. It’s becoming easier to receive revelation. I’m seeing my strength and desire to flee from sin growing. I’m praying and fasting for this. I’m becoming the person God wants and needs me to be. The desires of my heart are becoming pure and sanctified. I feel that soon my mind will be opened and God will truly unveil His face before my eyes. The veil is thinning and I’m walking towards it. It’s amazing, the power of the atonement. It’s changed me so much and brought me so much joy. I’m starting to understand eternity and exaltation.

highlights.title: Paula recognizes the Spirit
passages: Yesterday we had lesson that was really spiritual, with Paulo e Paula. Elder Garcia and I taught the Restoration. The Spirit was really strong. Paula felt it really strong. She said “Wow, I’m really feeling a really strong feeling of peace and Tranquility.” We explained that this is the Spirit.

highlights.title: Trusting God through a discouraging day
passages: It was a day that would have been easy to fall into discouragement; we didn’t have alot of people in sacrament meeting; and we didn’t have alot of visits marked, so a lot of our plans fell through. So we stopped for a moment, said a prayer together and decided to enter a neighborhood and just do contacts in front of houses. It still wasn’t bearing fruit.

So we decided to enter the street of Sueli to teach her and we saw a man entering his house. We did the contact, entered and taught him and he accepted baptism! We will return today to teach the rest of his family. Then after that we taught Sueli and Natália and marked their baptisms, too. The Lord blessed us as we worked hard and put our trust in Him.

highlights.title: An unexpected opportunity to teach Marcos
passages: 2 days ago I had a really good experience; a miracle. We went to teach Marcos, a contact we made 12 October. But alas, we did not find his house, so we figured that he lied to us and went and taught our other lessons.

So I was sitting in front of the Church waiting for the bus when Marcos appears wanting to be taught. At that same moment I received the call that the other Elders had entered the bus. So we went in to the chapel and I taught him the fastest Restoration lesson of my life: 5 minutes. And he accepted baptism!
It was a really cool experience for me and I’m glad the Lord helped it all come together.

highlights.title: Revelation through pondering and virtue
passages:
Yesterday night I was laying in bed, waiting to sleep, and I received some revelations; I also learned how to better receive such inspiration through virtue and constant pondering. The first revelation was a confirmation of the exhortation of my Patriarchal Blessing to continue to prepare myself for my life’s responsibilities through education and service. I was pondering about the Liahona and the Apostles. They have to give talks every conference and often write articles for the Liahona. And it struck me, you really have to prepare yourself to given amounts of trust in God’s kingdom here on Earth. Education will help me have a wealth (D&C 84:85) of knowledge, a database the Holy Ghost can access. And constant service is how to apply the knowledge I’ve gained and an opportunity to gain experience and further develop the attributes of Christ.

As I realized how amazing it was to receive revelation, I received some insight to Light. Just like how we’re blind without physical light, our mind’s eye needs spiritual light to see visions and receive revelations. To ponder is to open the mind’s eye. This removes darkness from the mind. (D&C 88:67)

Virtue is the ability to constantly ponder like this to receive such light.

highlights.title: A witness at the temple
passages: We did a tour of the Temple yesterday with Flaviana (member) and Tácio (not). It went really well. The Spirit is so strong at the Temple. God always testifies that it’s His house.

highlights.title: A peaceful, silent witness
passages: Today we had a really good lesson with Thais – Thiago’s girlfriend. I actually thought our teaching was normal, but for some reason the Spirit was really strong. And it wasn’t the burning spirit, but a really peaceful, silent, kind of spirit. I think it was so strong because the lesson had alot of testimony. Thiago bore a really good testimony about receiving an answer to the prayer to know if the book of Mormon is true. I truly believe that she will receive her answer as powerfully as is possible. I feel strongly that she is elect. It was a really good experience.

highlights.title: A change of heart during testimony
passages: We had a lesson with Luciana in Fernanda’s house. The lesson started and I felt hard to invite the Spirit there. But Reginaldo bore testimony with alot of power and before the closing prayer, after many many nos, she blurted out, “I want to be baptised!” It seemed really random, but the Lord did His work.

highlights.title: Sueli’s answer about the Book of Mormon
passages: She said she prayed and believes that the Book of Mormon is true, which is amazing. She’ll be a baptism in November. I feel that she has a lot of humility.

highlights.title: Faith and support at Luana’s baptism
passages: Luana arrived at church not even wanting to enter. It seems as though everyone she saw had something negative to say about the church. Relatives, friends, even random people on the bus. But after some lessons of faith and some help of the other girls of the ward we helped take away her doubts and it was a very spiritual baptism. I can’t seem to stop smiling at baptisms, I love it.

highlights.title: Courage, confirmation, and the words of Christ
passages: Sueli and Natalia were baptized. I was astounded by the courage Sueli displayed. She has a great fear – a phobia – of water, but she went down without a fight. When she was lifted out of the water she had a fault of air and almost fainted, but everyone helped her and it all worked out for the best. Natalia told me afterwards that she felt a great burning in her bosom when she was baptized. I explained that this was God. Later Sunday night we went to their house and Patricia talked alot to me. She is progressing and feeling the Spirit changing her life for the better. I explained Alma 32:28, and felt a great manifestation of the Spirit that I was speaking the words of Christ. Truly amazing. And after all this, Cristina, Natalia’s friend, said that she would like to be baptized! It was a really good day and a really good week. God gave us one miracle after another.

highlights.title: Fernanda’s dream answers her prayer
passages: She told us about a sacred experience she had. When she was about 6 years old, she dreamed about her Mom (who had passed away) in a place – a house – that made a deep impression in her mind and heart. But she never dreamed such a dream again. Recently, when she prayed to know if the Book of Mormon is true, she had the dream of that same house. She told us this crying, because she knew that God used this to answer her prayer, that He was communicating that her and her Mom could be together again after this life.

highlights.title: Light, obedience, and the mind’s eye
passages: I learned how light and truth work with the minds eye to enlighten the soul. I’ll try and describe this revelation but I know it’ll be difficult. We know that light is gained thru obedience and lost thru disobedience. This allows the minds eye to open and close. When we sin, our mind (our ability to ponder and perceive; especially on spiritual subjects) becomes foggy. It seems to me that this is the veil. Under the principles of righteousness our VISION is enhanced, our mind opens w/ LIGHT. The veil is thinned. And thus, revelation is more easily obtained. I think that this is inseperably connected w/ the presence of the Holy Ghost.

highlights.title: The Savior and angels at Fernanda’s baptism
passages: Yesterday was the baptism of Fernanda. It was the most spiritual baptism of the Mission. She is truly ready. She is truly an elect daughter of God. During the first prayer I had a knowledge stream into my head. I felt that truly the Savior was there, then I felt that truly Angels were there. Then I knew that her mom was there. I went to let her know that I had this revelation. It was a sacred moment to baptize her. I’m so grateful that she and God gave me this memory. It’s truly a treasure. I know it will be one of the best memories of my mission.

highlights.title: An unexpected invitation fulfills a promise
passages: Then as we were walking down the street a car passes us. And the guy said “hey are you the ones that were singing? I’m going to a party to be Santa, you guys wanna go with me and leave a message and sing?” So we jumped in the car with him and did the gig. It was in a closed condominium and only had eleitos there. We found about 5 families. It truly was a miracle and a fulfilling of our President’s promise.

highlights.title: A husband baptizes his wife
passages: The baptism of Daiane was way powerful. Sam was ordained to the priesthood and baptized her the same day. He baptized her and afterwards they hugged in front of the font. The Spirit was really strong. He testified the plan truly is about families; it truly is about Salvation and eternal happiness.

highlights.title: Words given while teaching Catarina’s family
passages: We did the 1st lesson and I felt the Spirit leading the whole time.
It was a challenge offering all those blessings to each as they accepted baptism – but God just kinda put the words in my mouth. It truly was a miracle.

highlights.title: A prompting while teaching the Word of Wisdom
passages: Yesterday we taught the Word of Wisdom – he accepted to start working on it. He smokes and drinks a bit, and of course, drinks coffee, too. I felt impressed to tell him that living the Word of Wisdom he would get his answer, and that Christ had put that in my heart. He responded well. He wants an answer.

highlights.title: Adair receives an answer while praying
passages: We had a really good lesson with Adair – he prayed with us and asked God if the Book of Mormon is true. He asked twice. And he closed his prayer in thanks for having felt the answer. It was really spiritual.

highlights.title: Light during a home dedication
passages: We also had a special visit with Dirce and Eva. We dedicated their house. The Spirit was strong, I felt light enter the room – and my body – as Elder Barbosa dedicated. Afterwards the spirit of the house was way different! One more witness that the Spirit is REAL. That God lives and that the Priesthood is Power, true Power. I thank God for these experiences and eternal blessings.

highlights.title: Recognizing the Holy Ghost together
passages: we just followed our impressions and started to teach about the Gift of the Holy Ghost. After bearing testimony a bit, João entered and sat with us. I decided to ask about the Word of Wisdom and if they were liking the Cevada. Fátima said she was trying to adjust, laughingly. This is when the Spirit entered the room: João looked at her and said, “Look, when Lehi was in the wilderness the Lord blessed their raw meat to be sweet so they could survive and be blessed following Him!” I looked at Elder Barbosa in awe. We testified that THIS is how the Holy Ghost works. That if they had dúvidas, this was the answer to their prayers! We all recognized the Spirit together.
This truly was an unforgettable experience. I’m grateful that the Lord strengthens my weaknesses and gives me Grace in His hands.

highlights.title: Fátima’s powerful confirmation
passages: The Miracle happened! The Lord showed His mighty hand! Irmã Fátima received her answer, the Holy Ghost entered her body and testified that the Restoration is TRUE!! She was overcome with alegria, her experience was similar to mine. I am amazed with the Lord’s work. This is why I’m here. To help God’s children receive this testimony.

highlights.title: Prayer and healing before baptism
passages: Fátima and Natália were baptized. The enemy tried to prevent it: Before church Natália got really sick. João said it was as though he thought she was dying; Fátima said she turned white, like a loss of Blood. They recognized it as a trial of faith and started to pray together – she was healed. The enemy wanted them to avoid baptism by making them go to the hospital. But they were true to the faith and trusted in the God of Israel, the God of Miracles and truth. After the baptism, and after the Bishop welcomed them to the ward, João stood up and bore his testimony – it was powerful. What a blessing it is to have found them – and that they were ready to receive the Gospel with open minds and open hearts. Truly a miracle.

highlights.title: Coming to know the Holy Ghost
passages: Yesterday we baptized João and “completed” their family. I feel really good about him. I know that the Lord has great plans for him. I’m super excited to return for their sealing, they’re already talking about it. It’s amazing how the Lord’s work is so true; how it progresses; how his elect children are waiting and searching and ready. Today we visited their house and I had a really strong experience with the Spirit that I wrote with my other experiences. It amazes me how we learn that the Holy Ghost IS a being, a person, not just a force. I got to know Him better today.

highlights.title: Comfort and strength through a blessing
passages: When we got home I asked Elder Barbosa to give me a blessing. I feel alot better. I feel like the enemy is holding me back alot – and it makes me sad. I was blessed to know that truly the power of Christ is available to help me. The spirit was strong.

highlights.title: Juliana’s experience during an ordination
passages: We’ve been teaching Juliana. She’s really elect. She was in the Bishop’s office when João was ordained Sacerdote. She said she felt a sensation in her body and heard a whisper in her ear. She said this happened as she was thinking about a relative who had passed away. We testified quickly about temple work and the feeling was the Holy Ghost. Tomorrow we’re gonna teach her the Plan of Salvation and about temples. It’s gonna be really spiritual. I felt the Spirit strong as she told us about her experience.

highlights.title: A witness of a promise before this life
passages: Teaching Juliana today, I testified to her that we were together in the Pre-Existence. That she knew her life would be hard here. But we were with her and promised her that we would find her and help her resolve her problems and find the true path to Christ. I felt the Spirit burn strong, and I know that this is true. I thank God that I am fulfilling that with which I was foreordained. What a great blessing it is to me, not to mention the countless others that I am able to serve.

highlights.title: The forgiving power of the Atonement
passages: My soul felt comforted today – I feel the forgiving power of the Atonement. My desire is growing – I pray that I can always align my actions with my desire. The Lord gives us the trials we need to change our hearts – little by little we are perfected in Him.

highlights.title: Filled with charity while teaching Juliana
passages: We also had a really good lesson with Juliana today. She was happy and I felt alot of sincerity. We reviewed the questions of the baptismal interview with her. We bore pure testimony. I was filled with Charity. She’s gonna make it. I’m so glad God is giving me these opportunities to make a difference in the lives of my brothers and sisters. It’s humbling to see the Spirit working miracles through me.

highlights.title: Hope in Juliana’s eyes
passages: Today was Juliana’s baptism. I’m really happy for the growth she’s having and that she is feeling the Holy Ghost. I know that she has a long way to go but she is making swift progress and I’m seeing the Hope in her eyes. I know that God had great plans of happiness for her and I look forward to seeing it play out. I pray that she can progress with faith and that she always has some form of support; and that her testimony of the restoration will blossom in her being. Irmã Fabiana is helping her alot and she came to watch her baptism. It’s amazing how God creates friendships and uses to do miracles. The hand of God is mighty to save.

highlights.title: Guided to offer comfort through the Atonement
passages: This morning Sister Yokoyama called really upset. She was crying. She was upset because Sister Barros was depressed – and in bad health – and had called President because she felt that she needed to go home. I listened. And I felt the Spirit guide me. I opened Preach my Gospel to the Atonement in the 2nd lesson, that mentions how it can cure us from our pains and sadness, and how everything can be corrected through the Atonement. I asked her if she believed in this promise, and if she believed that this promise is valid for Sister Barros too. She said yes and said she felt Him with her. I later spoke with Sister Barros and I think I was able to help lift her spirits a bit, at least we had a few laughs.

highlights.title: Guided to a family ready to return
passages: Today we also taught the family of Marcia, Letícia, Beatriz, Vitor. They are an inactive family, and their kids aren’t baptized. We left a first lesson and I really felt the Spirit alot. We were guided. I really felt that the Lord needs them for something. I also felt that they are ready to come back. I’m really grateful that the Lord is leading my work. Worthiness is key to recognizing and following the Spirit.

highlights.title: The Spirit’s help in comforting Sister Barros
passages: Sister Barros called tonight, sad. She’s passing through some tough times, but I feel that I was able to help her a bit – I felt the Spirit working. What a gift! I feel myself growing and becoming a better person – this is an answer to my prayers.

highlights.title: Communion with the Spirit changes desire
passages: I felt really good today in the fast and testimony meeting. I was really touched. I’m really feeling the Spirit in my life – an inner peace and a constant burning. I love it so much. Life is so much better like this. When we sin we truly are left to ourselves and the Spirit withdraws – and realizing just how good it is to commune with Him like this really does remove temptation from me. It helps me. If we can just choose to start living the principles, life is so much better and happier!

highlights.title: A confirmation of a call to serve
passages: The other day when I was praying, I received my confirmation that I was truly called for this calling – a frase from my Patriarcal Blessing popped into my head: “I bless you w/ the capacity and ability to grow and develop in your love for others and in your ability to meet their needs, and to sense in your heart how to accomplish the service in their behalf that needs to be performed.” I know that this is my mission here. I’m grateful for revelation.

highlights.title: Cidinha recognizes the Holy Ghost
passages: we had an amazing lesson with a woman named Cidinha. We read the Book of Mormon in 1st Nephi and explained Ch 12–14 about apostasy and the role of the Book of Mormon. As I was baring my testimony I felt the Spirit really strong and I told her “We’re feeling Him now!” She closed her eyes and a sublime look came over her face. We sat in silence for a few moments. It was really powerful. The power of the Holy Ghost truly is what converts.

highlights.title: Carol’s dream of Christ
passages: yesterday we followed up with Mara and Carol. Carol said she prayed and asked God if the Church is true and she dreamed that Christ appeared to her, with open arms, and told her it is. Wow. What a blessing!

highlights.title: Sharing the Spirit through music
passages: Yesterday Elder Swenson and I played a special musical number in Sacrament meeting (Nearer My God to Thee). He played piano and I violin. Although simply everyone loved it and said they really felt the Spirit. What a blessing it is to have a talent that other people like. It feels good to share it.

highlights.title: An unexpected encounter with Valdemar
passages: On the Bus I did a contact with a man that went to church and met w/ the Elders for 6 months in 2002. Valdemar is his name. We took his address and went straight to his house after lunch. He is going through depression as a withdrawal of bebidas – it has been one month since he’s stopped. We marked his baptism and gave him a blessing. I know that God placed him in our path, for many, many small factors and decisions led us to cross paths. God truly guides us.

highlights.title: A witness that the spirit lives on
passages: Aldo’s father passed away. They brought his body to the chapel and today is the service. When I viewed the body... it was interesting. I just knew that the Spirit still lived. It was an interesting feeling or thought – but it just made sense. His spirit is still in tact. We are eternal beings!

highlights.title: God touches Takiuchi’s heart
passages: In the afternoon I went with Junior to Takiuchi’s house and taught him the first lesson. He accepted the invitations, including baptism. It was a really good visit. When we stood up to leave, he suddenly started crying and said that God was touching his heart and showing him that he needed a change. It really was a sacred experience between us.

highlights.title: Orlanda recognizes the right time
passages: we were blessed with Orlanda’s baptism. It was a nice service, quick and to the point. Irmão Longo gave the message before the baptism and when he finished Orlanda bore testimony. She said that she should have been baptized long ago, but in all the other churches that she visited it never felt “right”. She said when she visited the church the first time she just knew that the time had arrived. It was a really good experience.

highlights.title: Finding a family after fasting for guidance
passages: We fasted today to be led to the people ready to accept the Gospel – and we found a new family – today we’re gonna teach them the restoration.

highlights.title: An answer to prayer for Tiago
passages: We’d been working with Neide’s family – and Tiago – her son – was baptized on Sunday. We really felt the help of the Lord with him. After church he got really shy and said he didn’t want to be baptized any more. Elder Wolp and I went to the second floor of the chapel, kneeled and prayed to help him. When we went to his house after lunch – he was excited to be baptized again! It was great.

highlights.title: Broken hearts and contrite spirits at baptism
passages: We had the Baptism of Alessandro, Ana, and Demilson.
Ana told us that she wanted to be baptized too, as a Surprise to Alessandro. It was really Sweet.

I had the privelege of baptizing the three of them.

It felt good. They all were there for the right motives. Their hearts are broken and their spirits contrite.

I am so grateful for all these experiences that God is giving me. When am I ever gonna have this much purpose and power to do so much good in the lives of others?

I’m so grateful that God has led me to meet these people, to show them the way and help them enter in to the path. I’m simply humbled. Am I really worthy of such happiness? I will do my best to honor the work that He is helping me do.

highlights.title: Elder Hunt’s words about a life of service
passages: I bore mine about experiences between us and others – service – and how serving others allows us to get to know Christ. I really felt the Spirit.

And then he told me that out of all the missionaries, I was the one that closest had the majesty of Joseph Smith. He became a bit emotional, and kinda walked off.

But wow. I don’t know what I did for him to think so much of me... Sometimes we never know when people are observing us, or how they view us.

But truly I was humbled. What a Sacred experience this was for me. I hope that I truly can have an impact like this in the lives of many.

highlights.title: Peace about an offering to the Lord
passages: Today we went to the Temple. It was the last time I’ll go on the mission.
It was good to see us all in the celestial room.

We’re so much stronger now because of the mission. And we’re all happy with our offering.

In spite of my flaws, I feel that the Lord is pleased with my work.

highlights.title: Following a simple prompting until the last moment
passages: What was nice is that I was calm the whole time. I kept a confidence in the Lord that it would work out somehow. I told Flávio that “we have to have faith even until the last moment!”
on the way I felt I should stop and ask some kids in the street if they knew him. They said they knew him but hadn’t seen him. We got back to his house and he still wasn’t there.
So, I just sat down in front of his house, prayed a little more, and waited. Within a few minutes he showed up – walking down the street!
I gave a “LIÇÃO DE FÉ” and thru the Spirit we got him back on board.

We got to the chapel at 8 and the baptism happened.

I endured to the last minute and followed the Spirit in the process and the Lord showed His mighty hand.

What had happened is that the kids in the street that I was inspired to talk to had found him and sent him over to us. How cool to see the Spirit work thru a simple thought. Had I of not followed the idea, the baptism might not of even happened!
I’m learning that the spirit is truly a peace and comfort – a feeling that everything is completely right.

attaining perfection – it is a commandment. If we have faith we can achieve all, even mortal perfection. That is, we can develop charity and other christlike attributes fully and completely here on earth.
He only wants the best for us and He will help us achieve all we seek after with faith in His name.
quotes.attribution: Teaching of Irmão Gonçalves, as recorded in the journal

passages: Perhaps spiritual gifts can come by expanding our mind and hearts; perhaps intelligence is truly the key...
I guess you never know how you affect other people.
I find it amazing how the Lord can work good, even through all of our mortal weaknesses, pride, and mistakes.

Truly God is all knowing and His love infinite. And when the two combine, it is the miracles we see in our lives; it is the miracle of our lives. “God is our heavenly father; He wants us to be happy and loves us;” for this reason I’m here; and this love I hope to help others discover, and continue to discover myself. It is this Love that He wants us to have with Him for Eternity; It is this Love which is life eternal.

First, always be trying to invite the Spirit; focus always on the mission. Then remember to give God credit for all of our good thoughts and ideas, because that is feeling the spirit. All things good are promptings from the spirit. It’s simple, but hard to be that humble.
quotes.attribution: Teaching of Irmão Gonçalves, as recorded in the journal

passages: A testimony comes only when you want it; or need it.
quotes.attribution: Devotional teaching, as recorded in the journal

passages: If you have a testimony thank God. If you don’t, ask God.
quotes.attribution: Devotional teaching, as recorded in the journal

passages: Humility is key – I believe this is why I’ve had so much success so far. I need to remember always to be grateful; the blessings will continue to flow.
if we truly love God we would keep His commandments perfectly.
Of course, perfection is something that takes work to achieve, and we can love Him in that process.

I desire God to help me consecrate my existence to Him, but it’s such a hard task to accomplish. I need to pray to know how to balance my personal life goals and desires with His plan for me. I need to discover his plan for me. I need to learn how to utilize my talents in a way that can align our interests or desires.
I want to receive the greatest blessings from God, and I’m willing to accept the responsibility that comes with them.
I think always being thankful is good for preparing for revelation. I sure does make everything better remembering it’s all from God.
The whole world needs the Gospel – and needs to be taught. If they haven’t been taught they cannot receive revelation. I am the light of the world – I need to shine.
The better I follow the commandments and Rules, the more I will be enlightened and be able to feel the promptings of the Spirit. I want to walk in the Light of the Lord.
Normally the Spirit will tell you to simply obey the rules as given, but it can, and most likely will at times, to break a rule (or commandment) to fulfill the higher purpose and law.
quotes.attribution: Teaching of Irmão Gonçalves, as recorded in the journal

passages: If I’m only looking to serve others, the Spirit will be able to make me a true Disciple, and a true Representative of Christ.
quotes.attribution: Teaching of Irmão Gonçalves, as recorded in the journal

passages: I pray God will bless me with strength to be obedient and diligent, for these will truly bring the blessings of Heaven.
without the personal revelation about their needs we are teaching in vain.
With pure Faith, miracles will happen. With Faith and obedience, I will get all the experiences during my mission that I desire. I will accomplish all that the Lord has for me.
This truly is a message of peace, to fill those unanswered yearnings of the human soul.
Yet somehow it is satisfying just knowing I’m serving to the best of my ability. The Lord will work in His time – this I know. Good will come from all that is performed with the right intent.
we need to develop Christ-like attributes to apply the Atonement in our lives.

It is Virtue, the ability to control our thoughts, that gives us godliness or the power to open the heavens. Because w/o Virtue, we are controlled by the adversary, worldliness, and the natural man. And when we are controlled by these external forces we cannot envoke the power of God. Virtue is essential for Faith to bring Miracles.

the Atonement is infinite; because it’s happening now. All points of time passed before Christ in that moment, so as we live and use our agency, we literally are deciding what sins he will pay for. So, when he says if you love me, keep my commands, he’s saying if you love me don’t commit the sin that will cause me to suffer – because the atonement is still happening now – even though the physical suffering occured in a single moment. It’s eternal because it’s not bound by time, is happening, was happening, yet all passed before Him in an instant.

I think this is a good opportunity to develop attributes that I’m lacking. He has a personality that I’ve never worked with before, so I think this is a blessing to grow in my ability to be more flexible to the situations God gives me in the future.
trust is more important than love, because trust has confidence and security, not just emotion.
quotes.attribution: Counsel of President Castro Deus, as recorded in the journal

passages: The mission is fun, everything seems so random, but in fact it is all the hand of God.
I know God has given me this challenge to help me learn and grow faster than I could have otherwise, I just need to practice my humility and let the Lord do His part in His time.
It was a taste of the pure love of Christ, that I could rejoice for someone I barely know.
Sometimes it’s easy to miss the miracles God is having you do because of doubt, and this was an experience that strengthened my faith.
My heart is settling in the right place, the Atonement will make up for the rest.
The Spirit World exists and their work needs to be done; they’re waiting.
An interesting thing happens to me at baptisms, I can’t seem to stop smiling. I receive a complete joy. It is such a feeling of peace and happiness – I think it’s a glimpse of the Celestial Kingdom.
The Gifts of the Spirit are true. I’m gaining a strong testimony of how we can do ALL things with the aid of the Lord.
It’s always good to have the faith of priesthood holders united in the work of Christ.

I have a really strong desire to be a better missionary, to give my all to the Lord, and to repent and make the changes in my heart – not just for the mission, but for my life. I want the courage to become like Jesus Christ. I need it, rather. My soul hungers to make my weaknesses strengths.

I have no doubt that the restored Gospel is true, and this special trust that the Lord has given me in the form of knowledge and sacred experiences is the base of need to change. I love my Savior, and I will do all in my power to keep His trust.
It’s amazing, the power of the atonement. It’s changed me so much and brought me so much joy.

you really have to prepare yourself to given amounts of trust in God’s kingdom here on Earth. Education will help me have a wealth (D&C 84:85) of knowledge, a database the Holy Ghost can access. And constant service is how to apply the knowledge I’ve gained and an opportunity to gain experience and further develop the attributes of Christ.

Just like how we’re blind without physical light, our mind’s eye needs spiritual light to see visions and receive revelations. To ponder is to open the mind’s eye. This removes darkness from the mind.
Virtue is the ability to constantly ponder like this to receive such light.
I know that he always fulfills his promises and that he hears and answers our prayers.

We know that light is gained thru obedience and lost thru disobedience. This allows the minds eye to open and close. When we sin, our mind (our ability to ponder and perceive; especially on spiritual subjects) becomes foggy. It seems to me that this is the veil. Under the principles of righteousness our VISION is enhanced, our mind opens w/ LIGHT. The veil is thinned. And thus, revelation is more easily obtained. I think that this is inseperably connected w/ the presence of the Holy Ghost.
Memorizing Scriptures truly sparks revelation and inspiration.
It’s truly amazing to me how the Lord answers our prayers in a way that is perfect for us, individually.
learning to love and learning to let go. Seem to be important lessons of Eternity.
the plan truly is about families; it truly is about Salvation and eternal happiness.
I have a great and marvelous work ahead of me – I just need to stand firm with my foundation in Christ.
There’s always a plan greater than what we see.
The Book of Mormon is incredible. The power it has to inspire the mind and teach principles is divine.

The priesthood is an amazing thing. Something I take for granted too often. There are 2 things I should ALWAYS keep in mind – the reality of the Atonement, and the reality of the Priesthood I’ve received. These are the keys to salvation.
He guides us, even when we don’t feel Him, because normally we only recognize afterwards.
It amazes me how we learn that the Holy Ghost IS a being, a person, not just a force. I got to know Him better today.
I don’t know why we felt so strong to work there if this was gonna happen, but I know that God will recompense our obedience.
The Lord gives us the trials we need to change our hearts – little by little we are perfected in Him.

It’s just a bit difficult to see how I can make a difference big enough to improve the state of things. I guess I just have to throw some snowballs and pray for an avalanche. God has something in store, I’m sure.

It’s amazing how the Lord prepares miracles when we don’t even realize it. I understood a bit more today about how His ways are not our ways – for He truly has a vision that is unimaginable. I am thankful that it is He that guides this work and not me – it’s much better this way!
I’m so glad God is giving me these opportunities to make a difference in the lives of my brothers and sisters. It’s humbling to see the Spirit working miracles through me.
It’s amazing how God creates friendships and uses to do miracles. The hand of God is mighty to save.
everything can be corrected through the Atonement.
Worthiness is key to recognizing and following the Spirit.
It really is through service that our gifts grow with divine aid.

In the end, it all comes down to the good that we do for others. This is what lasts. This is what is Eternal and Celestial. I feel Christ’s presence as I worry about others – I’m starting to recognize His love more fully.

When we sin we truly are left to ourselves and the Spirit withdraws – and realizing just how good it is to commune with Him like this really does remove temptation from me. It helps me. If we can just choose to start living the principles, life is so much better and happier!

I’d like to think that each contact is a seed that a future missionary will reap. I’ll never know the full outcome of my mission – nobody does. But I like the idea that I have the opportunity to influence lives. Members, non-members alike. What a blessing.
The power of the Holy Ghost truly is what converts.
But I believe in the Atonement and know that I can become who I want to be. I just need to have patience with myself and truly TRY to correct myself.
Worthyness and personal effort are so important to have the Spirit with us.
success as a missionary is determined by our DEDICATION
quotes.attribution: Preach My Gospel, chapter 1, as recorded in the journal

passages: His spirit is still in tact. We are eternal beings!
Christ suffered for all our pains.
imagine that moment when He took everything upon Him to pay Justice. Wow. How hard it must have been...

The fruits of the mission are without number and eternal.

I understand a bit better this process of Eternity and Salvation; this process of the love of God for ALL His Children.
serving others allows us to get to know Christ.
Sometimes we never know when people are observing us, or how they view us.
we have to have faith even until the last moment!
How cool to see the Spirit work thru a simple thought. Had I of not followed the idea, the baptism might not of even happened!
It has taught me to completely trust in God. Truly, everything works out when we trust His will.
I have felt the JOY that comes from dedicating ourselves to the Lord. It really is satisfying.
A confirmation of the Holy Ghost really is more powerful and more important than any miracle.
God truly consecrates our efforts to do great things – like an eternal snow ball effect.
I’ve felt the Power of Christ and His atonement. I think I understand it better. It is everything.
